name: cx-sequence
task: Find the key, pick it up, open the locked door, go into the room, and then pick up the ball.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard Existence(target_picked_up) with the Precedence chain (key_found before has_matching_key before target_door_open before target_room_entered before target_picked_up) forces every step of the task's stated order without any redundant Existence clauses.

texts: The key must have been found before it is picked up.
The matching key must be held before the locked door is opened.
The locked door must be open before entering the target room.
The target room must be entered before picking up the ball.
